subject: gov.protect
name: National cybersecurity strategy, response team and operations centre
what_would_settle_it: the promulgated cybersecurity law text, an agency establishment decree, or a national cybersecurity strategy

subject: tech.ai
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: AI system deployed in state service delivery
what_would_settle_it: a procurement notice, contract, pilot announcement or ministry statement naming a deployed system and a vendor

subject: finance.budget
name: Enacted appropriation for any year
what_would_settle_it: a text-extractable copy of any of the three enacted finance laws, at line grain

subject: finance.budget
name: Budget outturn at any grain
what_would_settle_it: a text-extractable quarterly execution report, or a settlement law later than 2019

subject: finance.sustain
name: Universal service fund receipts and disbursements
what_would_settle_it: ARCEP or CDCE accounts showing the 2% contribution collected and spent would settle it; probed 2026-09-25, the fund's implementation was still listed as a 2026 priority

subject: finance.sustain
name: Recurrent financing after the digital governance grant closes
what_would_settle_it: a finance-law line or transition plan carrying the running costs of systems built under the World Bank digital governance project after 31 December 2026 would settle it; probed 2026-09-25, none published

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Rule on where state data is hosted
what_would_settle_it: a hosting policy, cloud policy or decree fixing where state data sits would settle it; probed 2026-09-25, the GovTech index records none and the data-protection law addresses only personal-data transfers

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Hosting and contract terms of the identity database
what_would_settle_it: the identity-card production contract and a statement of where the database is hosted would settle it; probed 2026-09-25, neither published

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Data terms of the Huawei, Greenline and AIAL agreements
what_would_settle_it: publication of the agreements' data-jurisdiction, portability and exit clauses would settle it; probed 2026-09-25, none published
